Diagnosed: not a rollback bug. Audit: GDN state + conv tail checkpoint/restore, KV and PLE rewind are complete. Probe (new CLI --verify-probe, greedy decode n tokens then the same tokens through verifyGreedyPair with rollback after each pair, no sidecar needed), 2026-10-23 M1 Max: Qwen3.8 4-bit, 512 tokens, presence 0: 5/511 positions pick a different token, first at 136, all near-ties (decode top1-top2 <=0.22 logits, verify <=0.08); Qwen 3.6 4-bit, 256 tokens: 0/255 (only 6 margins <0.25 vs Qwen3.8's 35). Median |margin difference| 0.047 logits on Qwen 3.6. So the verify pass's prefill-kernel numerics flip near-tie argmaxes, which is what the char-553 greedy divergence of the 2026-09-21 MTP A/B looks like (position 136 ~ 550 chars). The B3 byte-identical gate cannot pass on the current verify path; the fix is a verify pass on the decode kernels, filed as its own bead.

No-go on measurement, 2026-10-23 M1 Max, 65054d17+probe, TINYTITAN_KERNEL_SPLIT=1 TINYTITAN_KERNEL_STATS=1, 128 greedy tokens: gdn.delta (the recurrent-state read/update/write) is 1.11 ms/token on Qwen 3.6 4-bit (30 linear layers, 60 MiB state r+w, ~105 GB/s) = 2.8% of a 39 ms token, and 1.83 ms/token on Qwen3.8 4-bit (36 linear layers, 108 MiB, ~115 GB/s) = 1.4% of a 132 ms token; gdn.conv adds 0.28/0.39 ms. DeltaLog's 7.8x write reduction is therefore bounded by ~1.4-2.8% end to end even if the state cost went to zero -- below this machine's run-to-run spread (9ul.1 A/A). Larger roles on the same profile: moe_phase1_2_routed, gdn.inproj, shared_expert, head.

No-go on simulation, 2026-10-23. Two Qwen3.8 4-bit TINYTITAN_PREFETCH_TRACE runs (prose, code; 255 decode positions x 48 layers, greedy) replayed through per-layer caches. At 128 slots: shipped LFU hit 0.856/0.846 (69/74 misses per token), LRU -4%/+8% misses, Belady oracle -34%/-28%; at 192 slots Belady only -9%/-11%; compulsory floor 42 misses/token. Belady limited to a perfect H-token forecast captures little: H=4 -5%, H=16 -12..16%, H=64 -24..29% (prose/code at 128 slots). So forecast-driven eviction needs near-perfect routing knowledge 16-64 tokens ahead, while the repo's best predictor is ~55% P@1 one layer ahead (qwen38-prefetch-predictor-study.md); and the cheap forecast proxies (aging-lfu, decayed score) were already measured washes and deleted (3eb11cf8).
